id: \bTracey: Sorry, I thought you were going to harm Lapras.
en: \bTracey: Sorry, I thought you were going to harm Lapras.
it: \bTracey: Scusa, pensavo che volessi fare del male a Lapras.

id: \bI won't get in your way. Take care.
en: \bI won't get in your way. Take care.
it: \bNon ti intralcerò. Abbi cura di te.

id: \bThere are many rare Pokémon on these islands.
en: \bThere are many rare Pokémon on these islands.
it: \bSu queste isole ci sono tanti Pokémon rari.

id: \rWelcome to the Pokémon Park! Here you can walk around and interact with some Pokémon.
en: \rWelcome to the Pokémon Park! Here you can walk around and interact with some Pokémon.
it: \rBenvenuto al Parco Pokémon! Qui puoi passeggiare e interagire con alcuni Pokémon.

id: \bDespite how peaceful it looks, we sometimes get severe storms here.
en: \bDespite how peaceful it looks, we sometimes get severe storms here.
it: \bAnche se sembra un posto tranquillo, a volte qui arrivano tempeste violente.

id: Lapras seems to trust you a bit.
en: Lapras seems to trust you a bit.
it: Lapras sembra fidarsi un po' di te.

id: Would you like to take Lapras with you?
en: Would you like to take Lapras with you?

id: \bWe just want to use that Pokémon.
en: \bWe just want to use that Pokémon.

id: \bWe don't have any other way to travel the islands.
en: \bWe don't have any other way to travel the islands.
it: \bNon abbiamo altri modi per spostarci tra le isole.
